children: SAID ON SUNDAY ITS UNIT UGL HAD WON A CONTRACT FOR APA'S SYBELLA SOLAR AND BATTERY PROJECT (BESS)IN MOUNT ISA, QUEENSLAND, AUSTRALIA
UGL WILL DELIVER THE ENGINEERING DESIGN, PROCUREMENT, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMISSIONING OF A 72 MW SOLAR FARM AND A 52 MW / 104 MWH BATTERY ENERGY STORAGE SYSTEM
CONSTRUCTION IS ANTICIPATED TO COMMENCE IN LATE 2026, WITH COMPLETION EXPECTED IN MID-2028
